title: Glass Stairwell v3
description: An emotive, glassy house cut with a swinging TR707 groove, chopped vocal-number stabs, a felt sine bass and lush sidechained pads. This version pulls every drum layer down to roughly half its former loudness so the kick, hats, claps and open hats now sit underneath the melody — letting the bass, pads, piano and vocal chops sit forward and breathe.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5).shape(0.3),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.25).swingBy(0.16, 8).cut(1).pan(0.6),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.5).mask("<1 1 0 1>")
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5).shape(0.3),

    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.34).swingBy(0.14, 8).room(0.2).delay(0.2),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(560).gain(0.55).mask("<1 1 0 1>"),

  [28, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.55).shape(0.4),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.29).swingBy(0.16, 8).cut(1).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2 1 4>")),

    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(720).gain(0.6).mask("<1 1 0 1>"),
